good_when: The maintainers read, in the concept, how invoicer holds its one way for the installer as well as for the accountant: what keeps the installer's setup of an accountant's machine leading to a command that prints invoices with nobody's further help, so a choice about setup leans the same way as a choice about printing. And each idea says what it gives the accountant toward a correct invoice, so the accounting team sees why they give the client's tax rate each time, and not only that the command remembers none.

An accountant reading what happens when something can't be read knows it is about the client's tax rate they gave, called by the same name as everywhere else, and doesn't wonder whether the 'value' to fix is some other figure, such as a cell in one of their spreadsheet lines.
